review_type: Fresh independent peer-source review of12S BMS UI wiring, fault visibility and preserved navigation/GPS/history contracts
checks: BMSViews provides explicit separate battery/BMS scan, selection and disconnect controls, linked identity and detected service UUID diagnostics. Device selection and scans reapply excludedVESC; this UI does not route those selections through the VESC connection manager.

BMS standard battery percentage is labeled separately from12cell voltages and guarded by current-clock freshness. Unknown cell protocol remains explicitly unavailable instead of treating percentage or pack voltage as individual cells.

BMSLiveCellsView observes manager state while pushed. BMSCellsView requires exactly12cells plus freshness for real readings, uses optional currentSnapshot and only indexes0..<12 after that count guard; non12, missing, future or stale snapshots cannot create a partial balanced-looking pack.

Cell grid shows measured per-index voltage, min/max and spread only with a complete valid snapshot. Nil/wrong-count/stale states show12unavailable entries and a reason. Periodic callbacks use Date() rather than an earlier scheduled timeline date.

BMSDemoView creates a pure immutable validated fixture outside the manager; sample and nil-unavailable scenes are routed through the common visible DEMO SAMPLE DATA header. No manager injection or persistence operation occurs in either demo view.

ContentView retains one BMS StateObject with startBluetooth:false across Home/connection/settings screens. Initial demo appearance and demo mode changes suspend that manager; both new launch flags also disable VESC radio initialization.

The root reapplies VESC exclusion on selectedPeripheralID changes and before opening BMS settings. Selecting a VESC device first excludes its ID from BMS. Home/settings/connection screens consistently receive the same retained manager; no unpatched initializer callsite was found.

Connect VESC and Connect battery BMS are separate actions in connection/home/settings UI. Opening a battery sheet leaves the existing Home and logging ownership intact. Live BMS cell view uses default real freshness; only pure demo uses sample bypass.

BatteryConfig fallback is changed from14to12series as the user specified; existing explicit saved pack configuration remains retained, and the BMS screen is explicitly independent from VESC percentage configuration.

Dashboard fault row consistently names ESC faults and distinguishes fresh None, active numeric+label and unavailable. Green/red/orange styling and outline improve visibility. New24pt fault height is subtracted from the viewport before allocating remaining hero/metric rows, so no unbudgeted new row is introduced.

Shared caption-free readout/inline-unit sizing and custom destination compass behavior remain intact. BMS demo adds one fifth page and changes selected launch tab only for its two flags; prior navigation/fault/destination launch routes remain available.

NavigationEstimate and its14tests, LocationManager, DestinationManager and RideHistoryView are unchanged against the independently reviewed9f384589 source. Prior finite coordinate/ETA, timestamp/source/gap/reset regression, critical arrival/reserve warning, GPS lifecycle and history guards remain applicable.

BMS view APIs use established SwiftUI NavigationStack/TimelineView/LazyVGrid with the watchOS10.6 target. Source review found no new access mismatch, force-unwrapped optional cell indexing or unsupported platform-only API. Native compilation is a separate gate.
scope_exclusions: Own-authored BMSManager.swift, BMSCellSnapshot.swift, BMSCellSnapshotTests.swift, Package.swift changes and BluetoothManager selectedPeripheralID getter are excluded from this independent approval; other councils review them.
Own prior protocol/decoder/BLE/stats/queue/snapshot/widget code and associated tests are also excluded from self-approval.
Browser preview/test scripts, project/CI configuration and handoff documentation are outside this scoped native source review.
This report does not assert native test/build execution, screenshot fit or interactive simulator behavior for97d32aa. Fresh18-image native review is pending.

Live per-cell vendor decoding is not implemented while BMS identity/protocol remains unidentified. Hardware dual connection, standard service support, actual sensor values, outdoor GPS/compass, prolonged background operation and on-water acceptance remain unverified.
